demos.title: Credential demo
demos.summary: Issue, verify, transfer and redeem a signed credential in two minutes, with no installation.

demos.title: Purchase demo
demos.summary: Buy something with a signed balance, then present a signed receipt to collect it.

demos.title: Login demo
demos.summary: Use a credential as a second factor at sign-in; revoke it and the next sign-in fails.

demos.title: Warranty demo
demos.summary: Follow a warranty certificate from factory to retailer to owner and through resales.

demos.title: Email ticket demo
demos.summary: Hand a credential to someone with only an email address. The send step is a mockup and emails nothing.
demos.needs: Nothing beyond the issuer. No mail is sent.

demos.title: Supply-chain recall demo
demos.summary: Recall a whole class of goods with one signed patch that reaches every current holder.

demos.title: Attestation demo
demos.summary: A second, independent key vouches for something it did not issue.
demos.needs: The domain's own reviewer key is created on first use in its own private storage; never copy one.

demos.title: Treasury approval demo
demos.summary: A treasury transfer that only executes once enough named officers have signed.

demos.title: Suspend and clawback demo
demos.summary: Freeze a stolen credential, then release it or claw it back to its rightful owner.
demos.needs: Writes the domain's own .well-known/atlas-suspensions.json, as the existing suspend route already does.

demos.title: Governance and voting demo
demos.summary: Open-enrolment voting: one vote each, a visible tally, closing at a fixed deadline.
demos.needs: Reviewer key created on first use in the domain's own private storage.

demos.title: Oracle-triggered payout demo
demos.summary: An independent flight-status oracle reports a delay and a payout mints automatically.
demos.needs: Reviewer key created on first use in the domain's own private storage.

demos.title: Reserve bank demo
demos.summary: Seven acts of a two-tier currency system, from reserve mint to audit and clawback.
demos.needs: Act 8 (consortium mint) needs an administrator login on each domain; the sibling field defaults to the other domain. The pinned example reads evtec.co.za.

demos.title: Cross-domain federation demo
demos.summary: Two real domains exchange a Post Office message, each checking the other's published key.
demos.needs: postOffice true in both manifests, outbound https from each domain's PHP to the other, and lib/replacement.php and atlas/asset/issue.php from this release on both domains (each accepts the other's pages for a Post Office membership only). The second domain defaults to the other site.

demos.title: Multi-domain transaction authorization lab
demos.summary: Two independently keyed domains must both sign a test transfer before it executes.
demos.needs: Its own private configuration, signing key and database per domain; off until configured (docs/txlab-deployment.md).

demos.title: Multi-issuer portable asset lab
demos.summary: One portable test asset issued jointly by two domains, exportable and verifiable anywhere.
demos.needs: Its own private configuration and signing key per domain; off until configured (docs/multi-issuer-deployment.md).

demos.title: Wallet bridge demo
demos.summary: A page asks the wallet extension who you are, for a signature or to keep an item, each with your approval.
demos.reason: It needs the ring offer in that domain's wallet-bridge policy, which evtec.co.za does not grant.

demos.title: Product page pinned to a spot in a world
demos.summary: An ordinary listing page whose spatial link points at the Compass Stall in Plaza.
demos.reason: It points at Plaza, a world only evtec.co.za declares.

demos.title: Blog post pinned to a spot in a world
demos.summary: An ordinary post whose spatial link points at the reading nook in the Lobby.
demos.reason: It points at the Lobby, a world only evtec.co.za declares.
